shared_elements: low-relief carving on a stone slab/monument
horizontal registers or banding of motifs
justification: Both depict anthropomorphic figures rendered in shallow, schematic low relief with elaborate headgear, worn chest ornaments and disc-like circular elements, and both organise motifs into horizontal zones. However A is a multi-figure narrative scene in profile arranged above a band of repeated glyph-like signs, while B is a single frontal three-dimensional bust whose body surface carries an isolated symmetrical arrangement of ornaments, so the compositional schemes and figure conventions differ substantially.
